_comment: Business terms with more than one reasonable meaning. When a question uses one (and nothing in it already settles the meaning), the server asks back with these options instead of letting the model guess. The chosen option's hint is added to the question, in English, for the model. Hints say what to do in the query, not just what the words mean: a vague hint lost to the Urdu verb it was clarifying (DECISIONS.md D43). Matched after normalize_for_matching(); Arabic-script terms and Latin terms of five letters or more also match as the start of a longer word (نفذ -> نفذها, fulfil -> fulfilled). See DECISIONS.md D43.
